title: Public Sector Salaries and the Quality of Governance: Evidence from Frontline Bureaucrats in India
title_zh: 公共部门薪酬与治理质量：来自印度一线官僚的证据
title_primary: 公共部门薪酬与治理质量：来自印度一线官僚的证据
title_secondary: Public Sector Salaries and the Quality of Governance: Evidence from Frontline Bureaucrats in India
authors: George, Siddharth Eapen, Mattsson, Martin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We examine the effects of increasing bureaucrat salaries, by analyzing a policy change in India that increased the salaries of a subset of frontline bureaucrats by 91 percent. Using a difference-indifferences design, we show that higher salaries (i) had no impact on performance, (ii) did not affect corrupt or dishonest behavior, (iii) reduced quit rates by 2.4 percentage points (16 percent) after 2 years, but did not affect the average quality of bureaucrats remaining in service. Higher salaries marginally increased effort among bureaucrats who were unhappy about their pay. Expert forecasters incorrectly predicted that higher salaries would improve bureaucrat performance and selection.
abstract_zh: 我们通过分析印度一项政策变革，该变革将部分一线官僚的薪资提高了91%，来考察增加官僚薪酬的影响。采用双重差分设计，我们发现更高的薪资（一）对绩效没有影响，（二）并未影响腐败或不诚实行为，（三）在两年后将离职率降低了2.4个百分点（16%），但并未影响留任官僚的平均素质。更高的薪资略微增加了那些对薪酬不满的官僚的努力程度。专家预测者错误地预期更高的薪资会改善官僚的绩效和选拔。

title: Office-seeking under demographic change: immigration, coalition government, and municipal budget reallocation in Sweden
title_zh: 人口变化下的职位追求：瑞典的移民、联合政府与市政预算再分配
title_primary: 人口变化下的职位追求：瑞典的移民、联合政府与市政预算再分配
title_secondary: Office-seeking under demographic change: immigration, coalition government, and municipal budget reallocation in Sweden
authors: Dennis Kolcava
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how local governments adjust public budgets following immigration-induced demographic change. It argues that office-seeking incumbents reallocate fiscal resources towards newcomers if these are expected to become voters within a short time horizon. Such adjustments are constrained by uncertainty within governing coalitions over who will capture any resulting electoral gains. The argument is evaluated using data from 290 Swedish municipalities between 2014 and 2023. Empirically, the analysis relates annual changes in budget shares across 11 expenditure categories to annual changes in the local non-EU foreign-born population share. The findings show that larger increases in the non-EU population share are associated with budgetary reallocation towards spending areas that are particularly relevant to these groups. Ideological differences between left- and right-leaning governing coalitions do little to condition these reallocations, whereas broader coalitions exhibit weaker fiscal adjustment. The paper contributes to public choice and political economy research by showing that fiscal responses to demographic change take the form less of uniform expansion than of strategic budget recomposition, and that such adjustment is weaker where coalition partners are uncertain about the distribution of electoral gains.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了地方政府如何根据移民引发的人口结构变化调整公共预算。研究认为，谋求连任的现任官员会倾向于将财政资源重新分配给新移民群体，前提是这些群体有望在短期内成为选民。此类调整受到执政联盟内部不确定性的制约——各方难以预判谁能最终获取由此产生的选举收益。基于2014至2023年间瑞典290个市镇的数据，本文通过实证分析将11类支出项目的年度预算份额变化与当地非欧盟裔外国出生人口占比的年度变动相关联。研究发现，非欧盟裔人口占比增幅较大的地区，其预算会向与该群体特别相关的支出领域倾斜。左翼与右翼执政联盟之间的意识形态差异对此类预算调整的影响甚微，而更广泛的执政联盟则表现出较弱的财政调整力度。本文对公共选择与政治经济学研究的贡献在于：揭示财政对人口结构变化的反应并非表现为均等扩张，而是呈现战略性预算重组特征；同时指出，当联盟伙伴对选举收益分配存在不确定性时，此类调整的力度会显著减弱。

title: Quantifying a Dangerous Obsession? Competitiveness and export performance in an OECD Panel of Industries
title_zh: 量化危险的执念？OECD行业面板中的竞争力和出口绩效
title_primary: 量化危险的执念？OECD行业面板中的竞争力和出口绩效
title_secondary: Quantifying a Dangerous Obsession? Competitiveness and export performance in an OECD Panel of Industries
authors: Wendy Carlin, John Van Reenen, Andrew J Glyn
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyses the impact of cost competitiveness and technology on export performance using a very rich panel dataset of 12 manufacturing industries in 14 OECD countries for the period between 1970 and 1992. Consistent with standard models, we find that changes in relative unit labour costs are a robust determinant of changes in export market shares. In the long run a 10% increase in relative unit labour costs leads to a fall of between 2% and 3% of export market share. Despite this, the trends in national export performance cannot be fully explained by relative costs. This points to the importance of non-price factors, and extending the model to allow for technology effects (including R&D and patents) on quality provides some evidence for the importance of higher relative investment rates. Allowing for heterogeneity in the effect of relative costs in different industries, different countries and different time periods suggests that labour cost changes are less important in high technology industries, in periods of high demand and in countries within the European Monetary System.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1970年至1992年间14个OECD国家12个制造业行业的丰富面板数据集，分析了成本竞争力与技术对出口绩效的影响。与标准模型一致，我们发现相对单位劳动力成本的变化是出口市场份额变化的稳健决定因素。长期来看，相对单位劳动力成本每上升10%，将导致出口市场份额下降2%至3%。尽管如此，国家出口绩效的趋势并不能完全由相对成本解释。这表明非价格因素的重要性，而将模型扩展至考虑技术效应（包括研发与专利）对质量的影响，则为更高相对投资率的重要性提供了部分证据。允许不同行业、不同国家及不同时期相对成本效应的异质性表明，在高技术行业、高需求时期以及欧洲货币体系成员国中，劳动力成本变化的重要性较低。

title: Self-Enforced Job Matching
title_zh: 自我执行的岗位匹配
title_primary: 自我执行的岗位匹配
title_secondary: Self-Enforced Job Matching
authors: Ce Liu, Ziwei Wang, Hanzhe Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Complementarities and peer effects are common in matching markets, yet incorporating them often leads to nonexistence of stable matchings. We observe that matching is often an ongoing process rather than a static allocation, where long-lived firms interact over time with short-lived workers. We show that when wages are flexible and firms are sufficiently patient, a dynamically stable solution always exists in many-to-one matching markets — even with complementarities and peer effects. Flexible wages are crucial to our result, as they not only facilitate surplus extraction when firms cooperate in no-poaching agreements but also enhance the threat of punishment through bidding wars. (JEL C72, C73, C78, D21, D62, J31, J41)
abstract_zh: 互补性与同伴效应在匹配市场中普遍存在，但将其纳入模型往往导致稳定匹配的缺失。我们观察到，匹配通常是一个持续的过程而非静态配置——长期存续的企业与短期工作的劳动者会随时间推移持续互动。研究表明，在工资具有灵活性且企业具备充分耐心的条件下，多对一匹配市场中始终存在动态稳定解——即便存在互补性与同伴效应。灵活工资机制对结论至关重要：它不仅在企业达成互不挖角协议时促进剩余提取，更能通过竞价战强化惩罚威胁。（JEL分类号：C72, C73, C78, D21, D62, J31, J41）

title: Bonus Question: How Does Flexible Incentive Pay Affect Unemployment Dynamics?
title_zh: 附加题：弹性激励薪酬如何影响失业动态？
title_primary: 附加题：弹性激励薪酬如何影响失业动态？
title_secondary: Bonus Question: How Does Flexible Incentive Pay Affect Unemployment Dynamics?
authors: Gaur, Meghana, Grigsby, John, Hazell, Jonathon, Ndiaye, Abdoulaye
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We introduce dynamic incentive contracts into a model of unemployment fluctuations. Our main result is that wage cyclicality from incentives does not affect the response of unemployment to productivity shocks. The response of unemployment is the same, to a first-order, in two economies: one with flexible incentive pay, and another with exogenously fixed wages. This equivalence is due to movements in effort. Under the optimal incentive contract, firms’ profits do not change when wages fall, because the effort of the worker falls too.
abstract_zh: 我们将动态激励合同引入失业波动模型。主要结论是，由激励产生的工资周期性变化不会影响失业对生产率冲击的反应。在一阶近似下，两个经济体的失业反应相同：一个采用灵活的激励薪酬，另一个采用外生固定的工资。这种等价性源于努力程度的变化。在最优激励合同下，当工资下降时，企业利润不会发生变化，因为工人的努力程度也随之下降。

title: Increasing Employment with Coarse Information
title_zh: 利用粗略信息增加就业
title_primary: 利用粗略信息增加就业
title_secondary: Increasing Employment with Coarse Information
authors: Chakravarty, Surajeet, Kaplan, Todd R., Lindsay, Luke
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We investigate whether an agency can increase employment by strategically coarsening information provided to employers about workers' skills. Theoretically, we find that such an increase is possible under fixed wages, and a range of employment levels can occur in equilibrium. We test this possibility using laboratory experiments under three conditions: full information, coarse and verifiable information, and coarse but not verifiable information. We find that, relative to full information, both coarse-information treatments increase employment at the expense of employers' profits, but not to the highest theoretically achievable levels. We also find that verifiability affects several aspects of behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们研究中介机构是否可以通过策略性地向雇主提供关于工人技能的粗化信息来增加就业。理论上，我们发现，在固定工资条件下，这种就业增长是可能的，且均衡状态下可能出现多种就业水平。我们通过实验室实验在三种条件下检验这一可能性：完全信息、粗化且可验证信息、以及粗化但不可验证信息。研究发现，相较于完全信息，两种粗化信息处理均以牺牲雇主利润为代价提高了就业水平，但未达到理论上的最高水平。此外，可验证性对行为的多个方面产生了影响。

title: Seconds of price discovery: Evidence from short-dated options
title_zh: 价格发现的秒级证据：来自短期期权的实证
title_primary: 价格发现的秒级证据：来自短期期权的实证
title_secondary: Seconds of price discovery: Evidence from short-dated options
authors: Frederick H. Willeboordse
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Short-dated options may reveal stock-price information before stock quotes update. I test this using delta-bound violation events: consecutive option trade pairs whose empirical delta exceeds the upper Black–Scholes–Merton bound for calls or falls below the lower bound for puts. Among 77.44 million 2025 trade pairs, these events predict 0.23 basis points of same-direction stock movement over the next second. The result is positive in every month, survives matched controls and WRDS TAQ NBBO reconstruction, and aligns with inferred hedge pressure.
abstract_zh: 短期期权可能在股票报价更新之前揭示股价信息。我通过德尔塔边界违反事件对此进行检验：连续期权交易对中，其实证德尔塔值超过看涨期权的布莱克-舒尔斯-默顿上界或低于看跌期权的下界。在2025年的7744万对交易中，这些事件预测了下一秒内同方向股票变动0.23个基点。该结果在每个月均为正，经匹配对照组和WRDS TAQ NBBO重建后依然稳健，并与推断的对冲压力相一致。

title: Cropland use consequences of a nationwide poverty alleviation relocation program in China
title_zh: 中国全国性扶贫搬迁计划对耕地利用的影响
title_primary: 中国全国性扶贫搬迁计划对耕地利用的影响
title_secondary: Cropland use consequences of a nationwide poverty alleviation relocation program in China
authors: Xinyuan Lei, Xiangwen Kong, Huanguang Qiu, Yawen Ding
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the impact of China’s nationwide Poverty Alleviation Relocation Program (PARP) on cropland abandonment. Utilizing four waves of household panel data across eight provinces, we exploit the staggered timing of relocations among households to identify its consequences on cropland use in origin villages. Our findings show that relocation increases cropland abandonment ratio by 7 percentage points. The observed changes in cropland use reflect relocated households’ rational behavior, driven by increased off-farm employment opportunities and higher farming costs in origin villages. Effects are more pronounced for households with steeper or lower-quality land, those resettled in urban areas, and those from villages not designated as national poor villages. Further analysis indicates that the Grain-for-Green program, along with agricultural industrial development projects and land rental policy, can help mitigate potential pressures on cropland abandonment. We then proposea typology-based framework to optimize land use policies across heterogeneous out-migration regions, aiming to support sustainable rural transformation in post-relocation contexts. Our findings highlight that PARP involves inherent trade-offs between local grain production, poverty alleviation, and ecological restoration.

title: Supply disruptions, economic slack, and the state‐dependent Phillips curve
title_zh: 供应中断、经济疲软与状态依赖型菲利普斯曲线
title_primary: 供应中断、经济疲软与状态依赖型菲利普斯曲线
title_secondary: Supply disruptions, economic slack, and the state‐dependent Phillips curve
authors: Ufuk Devrim Demirel, Matthew Wilson
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how supply disruptions and economic slack affect the responsiveness of inflation to changes in aggregate demand. We propose and estimate a nonlinear Phillips curve, whereby the sensitivity of inflation to changes in demand varies with supply conditions and the amount of slack in the economy. We find evidence that supply disruptions and low unemployment both steepen the Phillips curve, thereby amplifying the inflationary effects of increased demand. Our results suggest that the effects of fiscal policy on inflation depend on the prevailing supply conditions and the level of unemployment in the economy.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了供给中断与经济松弛如何影响通胀对总需求变化的响应程度。我们提出并估计了一个非线性菲利普斯曲线，其中通胀对需求变化的敏感度随供给状况和经济中的松弛程度而变化。研究发现，供给中断和低失业率均会使菲利普斯曲线陡峭化，从而放大需求增加带来的通胀效应。结果表明，财政政策对通胀的影响取决于经济中当前的供给状况和失业水平。

title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
title_zh: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制
title_primary: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制
title_secondary: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
authors: Hilde C. Bjørnland, Roberto Casarin, Marco Lorusso, Francesco Ravazzolo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的贝叶斯体制转换面板模型，分析了资源丰富经济体的财政政策。通过允许平均财政立场发生体制特定转变，识别出的体制捕捉了顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而体制间的转换则被解释为财政政策的变化。将该模型应用于由16个石油生产经济体组成的面板数据，我们发现在样本期内，财政政策多次在顺周期与逆周期体制之间交替。此外，我们发现顺周期体制下的财政政策波动性更大，且石油输出国组织（OPEC）国家处于顺周期体制的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，无论石油收入增加还是减少，政府支出的增长大多呈上升趋势，这暗示石油生产国存在支出向上偏倚。这些是文献中的新发现。

title: Ambiguity in performance pay: A real effort experiment
title_zh: 绩效薪酬中的模糊性：一项真实努力实验
title_primary: 绩效薪酬中的模糊性：一项真实努力实验
title_secondary: Ambiguity in performance pay: A real effort experiment
authors: David J. Cooper, David B. Johnson
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Many incentive plans are inherently ambiguous, lacking an explicit mapping between performance and compensation. We study the effect of ambiguous incentive plans on willingness to accept contracts to do a real-effort task, what types of individuals (low vs. high ability) accept the contract, the probability of completing the task, and performance on the task. The effect of ambiguous incentives is negative on multiple dimensions. Piece rate contracts significantly improve performance relative to fixed wages, primarily due to selection. This positive effect is not present with ambiguous incentives because high ability individuals are no more likely than low ability individuals to accept a contract with ambiguity. Modest levels of ambiguity about the relationship between performance and compensation are sufficient to reduce the probability that subjects choose and complete the task. Information about individual ability at the task reduces the probability that subjects choose and complete the task, but this is primarily due to decreased overconfidence rather than a reduction of uncertainty.

title: Lap-time dispersion as an aspect of within-race competitive balance in Formula One
title_zh: 单圈时间离散度作为一级方程式赛车内部竞争平衡的一个方面
title_primary: 单圈时间离散度作为一级方程式赛车内部竞争平衡的一个方面
title_secondary: Lap-time dispersion as an aspect of within-race competitive balance in Formula One
authors: Jonathan M. Lee, Cameron S. Prince, Lester A. Zeager
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Competitive balance in Formula One racing has different aspects. The existing literature measures uncertainty of outcome: concentration of wins, podium finishes, and season points among a few drivers or teams. The drama during the race, captured by measures of overtaking, has received attention recently. We propose another measure to capture the closeness of racing: lap-time dispersion, using detailed, lap-level data on each driver. To illustrate this measure, we compare lap-time dispersion in 16 races on the same tracks, under similar weather conditions, in the 2021 and 2022 seasons. Formula One made important rule changes prior to the 2022 season to improve competitive balance, focused on encouraging closer racing. Using quantile regression methods, we show that 2022 lap times decreased for the slowest drivers and increased for faster drivers, thus reducing lap-time dispersion, with the standard deviation of lap times and the Gini coefficient falling by 14.5% and 11.7%, respectively. The Lorenz curve for lap times also shifted significantly upward, indicating closer racing after the rule changes. Other aspects of competitive balance point in the same direction – lower concentration ratios for laps led and podium finishes – but the concentration ratio for wins rose substantially in 2022.

title: Language Constraints in Multi-Sender Communication Games
title_zh: 多发送者通信博弈中的语言约束
title_primary: 多发送者通信博弈中的语言约束
title_secondary: Language Constraints in Multi-Sender Communication Games
authors: Nicolas Rodriguez
official: 官方在线 2026-05-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies optimal communication under language constraints. The model features multiple Senders and a single Receiver, in which the only barrier to communication is a limitation imposed by language: Senders are identically informed, all players have aligned incentives, the state space is infinite, but the Senders’ message spaces are each finite. Thus, while players prefer full information revelation, their language does not allow for it. Efficient communication can always be sustained with a language in which the meaning of message profiles is convex, but the same does not hold for the meaning of individual messages.

title: How Does Progressivity Affect the Tax Cut Multiplier?
title_zh: 累进性如何影响减税乘数？
title_primary: 累进性如何影响减税乘数？
title_secondary: How Does Progressivity Affect the Tax Cut Multiplier?
authors: Christian Gillitzer
official: 官方在线 2026-04-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How does the targeting of personal income tax cuts affect the output multiplier? This paper provides quantitative evidence using a heterogeneous-agent New-Keynesian model calibrated to match US distributions of income, wealth, marginal tax rates, and marginal propensities to consume. Labor supply is determined by household preferences on the intensive margin and search frictions on the extensive margin. The model evaluates tax cuts for the bottom-90 (B90%) and top-10% of the income distribution in national and cross-region settings, replicating influential empirical research designs. B90 tax cuts generate larger output effects while incentive effects play a central role in transmission.

title: Are my team members pro-social? Information about social value orientation influences cooperation in public good games
title_zh: 我的团队成员是亲社会的吗？社会价值取向信息影响公共品博弈中的合作

authors: Edward Cartwright, Yidan Chai, Lian Xue
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We explore the effect of information about the pro-sociality of group members on public good contributions. We first provide a theoretical framework, based on psychological game theory, to model the influence of information about pro-sociality on first and second-order beliefs and thereby contributions. We subsequently report the results of three experiments in which we use social value orientation (SVO) as a measure of pro-sociality. We compare: (i) four networks of information: complete, star, pair and empty, and (ii) two information framings: identifying pro-socials versus pro-selfs. Our findings indicate that SVO information significantly boosts contributions, with enhancements ranging from 50% to 70% based on the group’s information structure. Regarding framing effects, we find evidence that emphasizing pro-social traits leads to higher contributions than emphasizing pro-self traits, though this effect emerges primarily after repeated interactions.

title: Equity auctions with bidder moral hazard
title_zh: 具有竞标者道德风险的股权拍卖
title_primary: 具有竞标者道德风险的股权拍卖
title_secondary: Equity auctions with bidder moral hazard
authors: Mingrui Gao, Xun Chen, Dazhong Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study considers standard equity auctions in the presence of winner’s post-auction effort as bidder moral hazard. The valuation of the auctioned object is endogenously determined by the winner’s effort and private type. We characterize the equilibria of the first-price equity auction (FPEA) and the second-price equity auction (SPEA) under various environments with bidder moral hazard. Regarding performance comparison, we identify the conditions under which the FPEA features, in equilibrium, a lower equity share payment, higher total surplus, equal bidder payoffs, and a higher seller payoff in expectation. Consequently, the FPEA Pareto dominates the SPEA in terms of expected bidder and seller payoffs. We further identify the conditions under which bidder payoff equivalence does not hold while the FPEA maintains an advantage in the expected total surplus and the expected seller payoff. Lastly, we compare equity auctions with fixed-royalty auctions under bidder moral hazard and investigate equity auctions under double moral hazard.

abstract: Using matched bank–firm‐level data and estimating difference‐in‐differences regressions around the 2014 depreciation of the euro, we show that exchange rate depreciations can lead to higher loan supply by raising banks' net worth. We focus on a new channel, interbank lending from large banks with high net dollar exposure to small banks without foreign‐currency asset exposure, but with a high share of exporting firms in their portfolio. We also find that German regions with such small banks experience higher output growth following the depreciation. These findings show the importance of banks' balance sheet structure and interbank markets in transmitting exchange rate shocks to the real economy.

abstract: We study how firms’ investment responds to interest rate changes based on a German firm survey, combining hypothetical vignettes, open-ended questions, and rich firm data. We estimate a 7 percent semi-elasticity of investment to loan rates—about half the total corporate investment response to monetary policy shocks. Adjustment is heterogeneous: many firms do not react, citing cash buffers or a lack of opportunities, while adjusters revise sharply. Managers’ narratives about monetary policy transmission to investment emphasize direct borrowing-cost effects and rarely mention general-equilibrium channels. Local projections show this direct channel is central to output dynamics after monetary policy shocks.
abstract_zh: 基于德国企业调查数据，结合假设情景模拟、开放式问题及丰富的企业微观数据，我们研究了企业投资如何响应利率变化。研究发现，投资对贷款利率的半弹性约为7%——约占企业总投资对货币政策冲击总响应幅度的一半。调整行为呈现异质性：许多企业因持有现金缓冲或缺乏投资机会而未作出反应，而进行调整的企业则显著修正投资计划。管理者关于货币政策传导至投资渠道的叙述强调直接借贷成本效应，极少提及一般均衡渠道。局部投影法分析表明，该直接渠道是货币政策冲击后产出动态的核心驱动因素。

abstract: This note discusses the empirical findings of Bahmani-Oskooee and Wang (2008), thereafter BOW. In their analysis, BOW suggest that the J-curve phenomenon holds in 22 US industries with China as a trading partner. However, it turns out that there is a misinterpretation of their findings. We show that the J-curve hypothesis is extremely questionable in at least 10 cases out of those 22 industries, claimed by BOW that the J-curve holds.

title: The passthrough of treasury supply to bank deposit funding
title_zh: 国债供给对银行存款融资的传导效应
title_primary: 国债供给对银行存款融资的传导效应
title_secondary: The passthrough of treasury supply to bank deposit funding
authors: W Li, Yiming Ma, Yang Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2019-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We demonstrate the passthrough of Treasury supply to bank deposits through bank market power. We show that a larger Treasury supply crowds out deposits with disproportionate effects in more competitive deposit markets. A larger Treasury supply further curtails bank lending and affects bank funding structure. The explanatory power of Treasury supply is not driven by other shocks to deposit demand and supply. In comparison, monetary policy rate hikes have a larger impact on deposit funding in more concentrated markets, consistent with the deposits channel of monetary policy. Our empirical findings are rationalized in a model of imperfect deposit competition.
abstract_zh: 我们证明了国债供给通过银行市场势力向银行存款的传导效应。研究表明，国债供给增加会挤出存款，且在竞争更激烈的存款市场中影响尤为显著。国债供给增加进一步抑制了银行贷款，并影响银行的融资结构。国债供给的解释力并非由存款需求与供给的其他冲击所驱动。相比之下，货币政策加息在更集中的市场中对存款融资影响更大，这与货币政策的存款渠道相符。我们的实证发现在一个不完全存款竞争模型中得到合理化解释。
